subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop replacements require explicit confirmation across every apply surface, or only add a second approval to agent-initiated calls?
rationale: The current patch changes the recently approved automatic agent workflow but leaves direct Gateway/UI and CLI behavior unchanged; selecting the permanent confirmation contract and intentional-rewrite UX requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Gate every apply surface
options.body: Have the service return a pre-write preview and require explicit confirmation for low-continuity replacements from agents, Gateway/UI, and CLI.

options.title: Gate agent calls only
options.body: Keep direct Gateway/UI and CLI applies immediately destructive while adding a second approval only for agent-tool calls.

options.title: Reject low continuity
options.body: Reject all low-continuity replacements and require users to revise proposals until they satisfy the heuristic.

recommendation.title: Gate every apply surface
recommendation.body: Have the service return a pre-write preview and require explicit confirmation for low-continuity replacements from agents, Gateway/UI, and CLI.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged approval-policy decision and its live workflow contract.
